tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /grub thob me long rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs/ oṃ

sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi snying po āḥhūm̐/ lung byang las/ /sna nam rdo rje bdud 'joms khyod/ /da dung skye ba 'ga' zhi ga brgyud/ /'gro don mi byed sbas tshul byed/ /lan gcig skye ba lnga brgya'i dus/ /chos nyid mngon du gyur pa yis/ /klong rdol mi yi seng ge ni/ /me long ming du btags pa 'byung*/ /de rjes o rgyan yul du mchi/ /'di thos sems can smin grol 'gyur/ /zhes o rgyan gyi lung byang chen mo nas gsungs so/ /oṃ āḥ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi phrin las hūm̐ hrī: oṃ ma ṇi pad+me yi dam gyi snying po hūṃ hrī/ 'das ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum bde gshegs chos kyi dbyings mchog kun gyi gi nor bu dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung bas bla ma rje/ /'gro drug thugs rjes sems can skyabs gnas dri med nyi zla lta bu'i sku/ /dug lnga'i nad kun sel byed gdam ngag sman mchog zab mo bdud rtsi mos gus can la ster mdzad pa'i/ / 'khor ba nasabaton pas drin can bla ma ma lus pa rnams la yid gus pas sku gsung thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / sku gsal ngo bo stong gnyis med zung 'jug ngang nas ci bsam pa dgos 'dod phun sum tshogs/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las bzhi yis 'gro ba 'dul dka' ba 'dul ba'i sku/ /smin dbang grol bskyed rdzogs byin rlabs chen pos ga zhan snang chos la bsgyur mdzad pa'i/ /yi dam mkha' 'gro'i gsang sngags kyi lha tshogs ma lus la yid gus pas sku gsung thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ zab pa gting gsal ye shes chen po'i rig pa 'od po che/ / gzhan na med rang shar dri med dag gi mdangs ldan sna lnga rigs lnga yab yum longs sku/ /byar med lhun gyis grub pa stong nyid dngos po med ngang du 'khor 'das ka dag pa'i/ /sems rang sems nyid kun tu bzang la gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod/ /kye bdag me long la

gus dad ldan skyo ngal med pa snying gi bu rnams spro phyir du/ /rnam thar gsal byed rdzun bden po bshad kyang gyi me long chos pa'i don du bri bar bya/ / sprang smyon zla ba mun sel mnyam med sbas pa'i rnal 'byor thugs kyi sprul pa ni/ /sa gtsang ri mtho sgrags nang 'gro mgon zhang rin po che'i dar phug gdan sa ru/ /me 'bar yum gyi lto na yod tsam na rmi ltas bzang po dpag med gsung 'khrul zhig yab bsam yas sras su dar phug tu 'khrungs/ /chung ngu'i dus lo gnyis nas gtor ma gtong na dge rtags dkar po'i gsol 'debs phyag dang chos spyod gtso bshad pa / / chos la sngon sbyangs sgrib g.yogs chung bas mngon shes phra mo 'di 'ong bya ba dang*/ /chu zla ba mun sel shul sprang po'i rgyu mtshan dus de nyid nas gsal/ / rgya gar du sngon du bsod nams bsog pa'i 'jur gegs kha nas phris byas pa'i zla gcig phyir bsrings pa'i rnam smin gyis/ /skye dman ma yis btud tshad 'khos chung bas byams par byas lags kyang*/ /mi go 'grims pas rgya gad shig gi ser ba sdug po rang byas babs/ / da shes med par nyung ma dang thal ba kur bas rtsa gnyid log du song ba dang dwa phrug than chen chos pas ma myong dgu gcig dkor chos med par nas bre gsum gyi zla ba gcig thub pa byas myong*/ /de dus 'chi ba dran nas gsol ba mang po btab te nyin mtshan med par ngus/ /grub thob mched gnyis za lung pa dang mkhan chen se lung pas drin can gcig yin zhi byed lam gsum phag mor lugs in+d+ra bhu ti'i thabs lam dam pa 'phyar chung gi gsang sgrub phag nag bka' ma zhus / /lo dgu ngo bcu 'i dus su zhang po sgom chen pa gcig gis khrid nas btsun chung byas te 'dul khrims lo bcu bdun tshun chad bsrungs/ /de dus dbyar dgun lnga tsam zangs mtshor sgom lo byas pa'i tshe/ /'dre rtog cho 'phrul ban dhe gcig gis dngos su chir chir mnan

chen po byung ba'i lo rgyus dang*/ /phyi nam mkha' nang sems stong par rtogs pas lus po 'di med na gcig tu 'dug pa snyam nas shi na dga' snyam byung*/ / nyams dbyangs blangs mched grogs kun gyis dus la ma babs zer kha dgags sngar stong nyid ting 'dzin 'gribs/ bco lnga lon pa'i dus su seng ge rgyab tu grub thob za lung pa'i zhal nas khyod rang gi bla ma ban rgan yin pas bgres yod par 'dug song gsung phyin/ brtse bas thugs kyis bzung nas gtsug gi rgyan gcig 'bral med mdzad/ /zla bzhi gzim khang bla yir 'bral med brten nas zla drug lon tshe zla ba gnyis snyung lug zla'i tshes bcu bzhi la gshegs/ / drin chen pos dran chog mos gus thob pas rmi lam du chos mang po gsungs bslab bya mang po mdzad o rgyan na yod gsung rten rnams lag tu byon/ /bcu drug lon tshe rgan mo thugs rje zer ba gcig gis byas pas gnyis ka 'tshengs zhogs stengs brgya tshar glegs bam byas lags pas/ bka' yi mtha' bral stong pa don rig rang sems nam mkha' lta bur rtogs/ / yid la dran pa la lhag ma bzhag par dran snang dbyangs su blangs shing smyon pa'i spyod pa byas/ /stag sgo mkhar chu ri brag gnyen khrod dben sa brten/ /chu 'thung rde 'u 'bru chen bdud rtsi'i bcud len lo mang po byas/ / g.yu brag dab dung lung du nas bre gang gis zla gcig nyi shu thub par lo nyi shu rtsa lnga phan chad la byas/ khyi spags gdan re ras rkyang re la brten pa dang*/ / dka' da ma shi'i bar du nas khal gnyis las mang batshag mi byed pa dang mtshams dang them spangs dang 'dag char dang smra bcad byas nas sgrub pa la 'bungs ba yin spyad sdug ba sran bskyed nas chos kyi phyogs su 'bungs/ /bco brgyad lon tshe 'gran med sangs rgyas dbon po rgyal mtshan yis/ / rdzogs chen snying thig ngo sprad chos nyid mngon sum seng ge rgyab tu bstan/ / yin lo tsam la

yid dpyod la ma brten sku gsum rjen par rdo rje sems dpa' dngos su mthong*/ /mthong lo tsam du go bar ma shong ma gyur snang srid dbyings rnam par dag pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ /de 'dzin zhen pa med stong par rtogs pas 'khor 'das tshig gi brjod gzhi bral/ /rdzogs chen brgyud pa rnams dang rmi lam nang du mjal/ /gdung shugs dga' ba'i sems kyis brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs byas/ /rtsa gsum lon tshe gung thang dar chu bar phug tu mnyam med sangs rgyas ras pa la/ /rdo rje phag mo la sogs gter chos ma lus pa lung mang po zhus / /'khrul gcod bka' rgya ma dang gdam ngag dpag med zhus/ /dgos 'dod chos kyi gter rnyed phongs pa'i dbul ba bsal gzhan la tshol ma dgos / /dbyar dgun gsum tsam brten nas bla ma dgung la gshegs sbrul lo'i tshes bcu la //'bral med rmi lam du mjal nas chos mang po gsungs phag mo klu 'dul gyi lung gnang phyis kyang mjal ba yin gsungs snying la bcangs pas byin rlabs rgyun chad med/ /rtsa bzhi lon tshe ye shes phag mo nyid dang mjal ka ba can du sbyin sreg byas pas brag phug 'od kyis bkang rdo la rjes byung / /zog po'i rdzun rkyal rdzun yin zer te rdzun la zad pa med de bsdus la thong rjes bkra ri mo che mthong chung mthong rdol ba kun gyi thugs la gsal/ /'on kyang bstan gtso sgrol ma dad na spro phyir ka ba can du 'khor ba dong sprugs/ phyag stong spyan stong*/ ka ba can du kun bzang yab yum dang*/ o rgyan dam pa dbu rdeb/ jo mo/ zhang rin po che/ seng ge rgyab pa/ sangs rgyas ras pa/ za lung pa/ zhig po shes rab/ rgod tshang pa/ ri bo sgang pa/ pha rgan bsam ye/ zhig mo rang grol rnams mthong thugs rje chen po dang*/ /lhan skyes rta mgrin mkha' 'gro bla ma bcu gsum rnams/ /gsal dag 'ja' 'od dkyil na dngos su bzhugs pa mthong*/ /mos gus gdung ba'i yid kyis gsol ba btab pa'i tshe/

/e ma nam mkha' nas gsungs blo bral sems kyi gnas lugs brjod gzhi bral/ /lta sgom spyod 'bras med par sems thag chod/ /skal ldan snying po rtogs pas rgyal ba'i sras/ /tshul chos 'dzin pa thongs shig rnal 'byor pa/ / zhes gsungs mi snang nam mkha'i dbyings su yal nas thal/ /bla ma'i bzhugs gnas seng ge rgyab dung lung nyid du bsdad pa'i tshe/ /yid 'ong bu mo gzhon pa'i gsung dbyangs snyan po yis/ /gzugs med āḥhūm̐ sgra yis bar snang khams rnams nam phyaid yol tsam na gang*/ /yang chos rdzong du dus tshes bcu gcig gi tho rangs sgra gcig grags/ /gnyid sad mkha' la bltas tshe mkha' 'gro lnga bzhi yis/ /mgrin gcig bsdebs te snyan pa'i gsung dbyangs 'di ltar thos/ /e ma blo bde'i mal du chos nyid rdzogs chen snying thig don bltas pas/ /skye rgyun 'dis chod mngal sgo mi 'grims nam mkha'i rnal 'byor pa/ /bsgrub mkha' 'gro'i rim srog 'phrog babru lnga'i snying po rgyun bzlas pas/ /'bral med zhal bzhes stong grogs bya yis snying gi bu/ /zhes gsungs ting gi sgra 'ur 'ur ltar thag chod pa' ི lung bstan dngos su thob/ /yang nyin phyed yol tsam na gnyid du song ba'i rmi lam du mthong bas lus sbrid la gnyid sad tsa na nam mkha' la cig ka ba can du tshes grangs bcu gnyis la/ /phag mo zhal dngos su mthong dmar mo dang grub thob za lung pa/ /gnyis med nam mkha'i dkyil du 'od du 'bar ba mthong*/ /zhen med mchog gi dngos grub sprang po nyid kyis thob/ / bla ma sangs rgyas ras pa 'i gshegs shul dar chung nyid du bsdad pa'i tshe/ /rmi lam phag mo tshes bcu gsum gyi nub ma ོ 'khor bcas snying po 'bru lnga sgrog cing byon/ /de dus sa g.yos gnyid sad dmar po phub tsam pa'i dkyil du 'od khru gang ba gcig byung 'od kyi phag mo mthong*/ / mi las rgyal ba'i sras po rang gi bu chung skyes pa'i dus

'ja' tshon ring bsrel sgra ru bcas/ / sprang po gnas mchog dpal gyi skyabs gnas rdzong du bsdad pa'i tshe/ / bla ma bla ma sku gshegs za lung pa/ sangs rgyas ras pa/ sangs rgyas dpon po/ bla ma gu ru ba/ rnam lnga mkha' 'gro rdo rje sems dpa' tshes bco lnga'i nub mo mkha' 'gro sde lnga rdo rje sems dpa' yis/ /rmi lam khyad 'phags rdzogs chen dkyil 'khor zhal phye bum dbang gsang dbang shes rab ye shes dbang tshig dbang rin po che bzhi pa'i dbang ngo bzhi rdzogs dbang*/ /brda don zab mos ngo sprad rigs lnga yab yum mthong*/ /bar chad rkyen rnams mang yang bsdad du ma byung yang bar chad mang bas rigs pa 'ur te thon rjes phur ba chu brag me la brtul zhugs so rtags la bsam mi khyab/ /e ma sngags gsar rnying gdams pa'i gnas yod rjes 'jug dad yod rnams ya mtshan skye/ / rtsa drug lon tshe shān+ti ba'i dbang bzhi rdzogs pa ri khrod 'khrul mchu snom ma bu tshogs drug la sogs pa zhig dar ma la/ /gsang sngags thabs lam gnad zhus ci byas chos su btang*/ / tshe 'dir skur pa mi kha za yang rang nyid don dang ldan/ /sprul sku rgya mtsho'i mtshan can chos kyi 'brel ba'i bla ma grub thob gzhon nu 'bum/ /theg chen snying po'i don gsung dug rnams zas su gyur/ /lha ri 'gro ba'i mgon po dbang phyug chos rje 'brug pa'i gdam ngag phag sna rdo rje gdan pa dang*/ /mkhas btsun grub thob brten nas gdams ngag dpag med zhus/ /lar ni mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma bcu gsum brten/ /'gran zla rtsod pa bral ba'i bla ma rnams seṅge rgyab pa/ sangs rgyas ras pa/ grub thob za lung pa gsum lags/ /khyad 'phags rdzogs chen 'di las lhag pa med dran mchog bla ma gu ru la/ /gsang ba snying tig rgyud rnams pha pad gnyis kyis zhus/ /da lta sum cu lon nas ma shi'i bar du yang*/ /'jig rten sgyu ma'i nor la zhen pa spu tsam med/ /smyo 'di mi byed bya ba med pa

spyod byis pa'i rnam thar ngo tsha kha nas thon tshad dang sba gsang bral/ /lha zhal mang po mthong sku 'bum phrag zhi khro'i lha tshogs zhal mthong der 'dzin blo sems stor nga rgyal med / khros ma'i snying rlung zhugs pas gzhan dbang 'ur 'grogs khong na zhe bcad yod pas gcig mi gtong*/ /byin rlabs nyams rmi lam tsam sgyu ma tsam brag dang chu dang me dang mtshon myong 'ur na thams cad rdzun po yin/ /'di yin bden zla ba mun sel nam 'chi mi rtag pa med do don rang ngo sems nam mkha' lta bu bos stod/ / mos gus can 'bral med byin brlabs 'byung gi rjes don gnyis 'jug bsgrub la rem/ /me long zog ma byas bslus pa gdam ngag zab chos bshad med do bsam mno legs par thongs gtan du mi 'grogs / /sgyu lus mgo zing 'di g.yar po yin pas 'byung ba bzhi la gtod/ /las su dmigs med chos rang byas pas dpa' bo mkha' 'gros zog ma byas bsu/ /bla ma rang gi sems su byon pas gnyis gcig yin chu la chu thim dbyings su dbyer mi phyed/ / 'ja' dang 'od dkar ser sna lnga dang sgra dang rtags rnams sku gdung 'bar ba las bshad pa bzhin ma lus pa/ / mig gis mthong rna bas thos yid kyis dran par gyur pa'i chos 'di bden pa'i yon tan sems can las ngan pa'i blor mi shongs/ /'on kyang byin rlabs kyis ma lus kun bzang klong du nye bar 'gyur/ /'di bris dge bas 'gro drug ma lus pa/ /rnam dag ye shes klong du sgyu lus dag gyur nas/ /gnyis chos mi rtog pa'i ting nge 'dzin skyes te bde ba chen po la 'khod do med kyi dbyings su mya ngan 'da' gyur cig /me long rdo rje'i rnam thar gsal byed rdzun gyi me long zhes bya ba/ dad gus can gyi dpon kun gyis yang yang bskul nas/ bya lo zla ba dang po'i tshes bco lnga la tshar bar bris pa lags so/ /oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ hrī/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hrī/ 'bar kha'i mi kha bsdus kyang e ma g.yas re chung*/

he he he/ bla ma dam pa des 'das rjes gsungs pa/ nga 'gro skye med chos kyi dbyings su 'gro/ /rdzogs chen rnal 'byor dud yal nam mkha' 'dra/ /stong nyid sad chen 'khrul rtog sprin tshogs gtor/ / chos sku'i snang ba yin no e ma ho/ /snying tig rnal 'byor bar snang 'ja' tshon 'dra/ /rang rig shel sgong khri gdugs 'od dang mjal/ /longs sku'i snang ba yin no e ma ho/ /rgya grol rnal 'byor nam langs nyi shar 'dra/ /'khor 'das kun khyab gang mos der snang ston/ /sprul sku'i snang ba yin no e ma ho/ /ngo bo stong pa'i dbyings ni bsam brjod bral/ /de la nga thim dge bas phan ma btags/ /rang bzhin 'od lnga'i dbyings na zhi khro gsal/ /de nyid nga yin sdig pas gnod ma bskyal/ /thugs rje 'gag med dbyings ni sna tshogs ldan/ /de la ngas khyab 'bral med sku gsum dang*/ /sprang po ye shes lus su gyur pa la/ /med snyam ma sems 'bral med nyag gcig ltos/ /don med rag sku ma byed sgrub la 'bungs/ /gang 'byor bla ma'i gsung yin phyogs med mchod/ /skyon rtogs 'thab rtsod ma byed khyi phyug spongs/ /ngas bshad gdams pa nyams long gsol ba thob/ /chags sdang rjes chod thig le nyag gcig ltas/ /zhen med rnam thar yin no lad mo zlos/ /ri khrod pha yul yin no bya ba thong*/ /de ltar byas na skyid 'byung mngon sangs rgya/ /zhes phyi rabs kyi don du snang bar byas so// //rgya rgya/ dge'o// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (4)grub thob me long rdo rje'i rnam thar bzhugs/ -PAGE 152--PAGE 153--PAGE 146-
